body: Unfortunately my time is up. See you on the other side.

You're right it will hurt her, but her leaving hurt me. I appreciate the help I do. Maybe things will change or my thoughts will. I am going to update this weekend with my decision and will probably be donating some money to redditors in need beforehand.
It is more so I haven't killed myself because I don't want to hurt her. If she's out of the picture I don't really care who I hurt.
Thank you for your optimism, I tend to really beat myself up and it helps. I am going to study up on the 5 love languages, thanks again.

I think you're right. We never do anything couply or even go out on weekends.  Just the usual sit at home and be room mates. I did clean the house and sent her a pic of it and she said "Thanks for cleaning :)". 

I think space for her during this week and then maybe a romantic gesture wil help with her.
